data.message: Individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal: I commit to request 18 tons this month. Each switch from 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, leaving 250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Even at k=25, 50 remain, but recovery to 500 isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
